Terrain parks 4 vs 5 across third-party sources, left unknown. Lift types (search summary 2026-09-30; skiresort.info https://www.skiresort.info/ski-resort/holiday-valley/ski-lifts/): 11 chairs and 2 carpets (Boardwalk, Slippery Streets; stored as other), 27,700/h. Named chairs: Mardi Gras Express six (2023); Morning Star (2010), Tannenbaum Express (2003) and Yodeler Express (2021) high-speed quads; Spruce Lake, Creekside, Chute, Sunrise, Cindy's and Eagle fixed quads (one more chair not named in the summary). A 2027 chairlift replacement was announced (https://unofficialnetworks.com/2026/09/15/holiday-valley-new-chairlift/).

features.beginnerArea: Learning Zone at the Holiday Valley Lodge / Creekside side: Slippery Streets and Boardwalk surface lifts plus the School Haus chairlift

source.note: Snowmaking 95% from the NYSkiBlog directory. Tubing park (24 lanes, ages 7+, 42 in. minimum) is a separate site on Bryant Hill Rd. Daycare for 6 months-5 years inside Holiday Valley Lodge (official pages).

character: Large multi-lodge resort beside the village of Ellicottville, with about 60 trails spread over several interconnected faces, 13 lifts and extensive night skiing. It has slopeside lodging, a separate tubing park and a ski-town setting.
learning: The Learning Zone has two surface lifts (Slippery Streets, Boardwalk) and the beginner-only School Haus chair, and a beginner-area ticket covers only those. First-timer packages for ages 12+ bundle a School Haus area ticket, rental and a 1.5-hour group lesson; another group lesson option includes a 4-hour Learning Zone ticket and 4-hour rental. Kids' programs: Cubs (ages 4-5) and Mountain Adventures (6-11). Rent at the Main Lodge rental shop, then check in for lessons at Creekside Lodge. January is promoted as Learn a Snowsport Month.

source.note: Had targeted Nov 28, 2025 (weather permitting); opened Fri Dec 5, 2025 with day and night skiing 9am-10pm. Closing date not found.

season.typicalText: Usually targets the day after Thanksgiving and opens late November to early December depending on weather: Fri Dec 5, 2025 (after a Nov 28 target) and Fri Dec 6, 2024. Night skiing usually ends in mid-March.
season.notes: No official 2026-27 opening date found as of 2026-09-28; in past seasons the resort announced a day-after-Thanksgiving target in the fall. OnTheSnow (third party) projects an opening of 2026-11-27 and closing of 2027-04-04; these are projections, not announcements (https://www.onthesnow.com/new-york/holiday-valley/ski-resort). 2026-27 lift tickets go on sale Thu Oct 1, 2026 (https://www.holidayvalley.com/lift-tickets/).
